summary: std/uuid: `uuid.parse` of some texts holding multi-byte characters faulted while building its error, so a program parsing a peer's UUID text could be stopped
details: `uuid.parse` of some texts holding multi-byte characters faulted while building its error, so a program parsing a peer's UUID text could be stopped; it now answers google/uuid's error. Affected: 0.51.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/uuid, native backends): `uuid.parse` of some texts holding multi-byte characters faulted while building its error, so a program parsing a peer's UUID text could be stopped; it now answers google/uuid's error. Affected: 0.51.1 and earlier.
